blocks.text: Fluoroquinolones masnooi jaraseem kush maadde hain, aisi bactericidal antibiotics jo bacterial DNA replication rok kar infections ka ilaaj karti hain. Kitab inhein chloroquine ki tayyari ke zimni maadde se jorti hai, jo khud quinine ki masnooi tabdeeli hai, yaani South American Cinchona darakht ki chhaal ka alkaloid, aur in ki daryaft George Lesher (1962) se mansoob karti hai. In se ahem lekin kam hone wale zimni asraat juray hain, jaise tendon ka phatna, peripheral neuropathy aur dil ke masail, aur dawa ki muzahimat bhi.

items: Bactericidal: yeh DNA replication ke enzymes ko aise complex mein phansati hain jo DNA ke dono strands torta hai, is liye bacteria afzaish nahi kar sakte aur mar jate hain.
Yeh bacterial cells mein ja kar type II topoisomerases rokti hain.
Gram-positive bacteria mein yeh zyada tar topoisomerase IV ko nishana banati aur replicate shuda DNA ke alag hone ko rokti hain.
Gram-negative bacteria mein yeh zyada tar DNA gyrase ko nishana banati aur replication mein DNA ke khulne ko rokti hain.

blocks.title: Mukhtasar tareekh
blocks.text: George Lesher ki 1962 ki daryaft nalidixic acid thi, pehli quinolone, jo chloroquine ki tayyari ke zimni maadde ke taur par mili. Baad mein (1970s aur 1980s se) quinolone ki banawat mein fluorine lagane se zyada taqatwar fluoroquinolones bani.

blocks.prompt: Gram-negative bacteria mein fluoroquinolones zyada tar kis enzyme ko nishana banati hain?
blocks.explanation: DNA gyrase, jo replication mein DNA kholta hai (Gram-positive mein zyada tar topoisomerase IV).

items: Fluoroquinolones: masnooi, bactericidal; type II topoisomerases rokti.
Gyrase (Gram-negative), topoisomerase IV (Gram-positive); DNA tootna cell maarta.
